body: Tested 2026-11-19 from a non-Indian cloud IP. www.nseindia.com now 301-redirects to www.nseindia.in (Akamai returns 403 to thin header sets). On www.nseindia.in the /api/ corporate endpoints return JSON WITHOUT a cookie if the request sends a browser User-Agent, Accept json, Accept-Language and Referer https://www.nseindia.in/. They work over HTTP/1.1, so Python urllib works. Working endpoints: corporate-announcements (per symbol: full history, 727 rows for KPITTECH back to 2019; or all companies by from_date/to_date), corporate-share-holdings-master, corporate-pledgedata (per symbol or all), corporate-sast-reg29, corporates-pit (per symbol; the all-market date form returned empty), corporates-financial-results, historicalOR/bulk-block-short-deals (optionType=bulk_deals|block_deals), snapshot-capital-market-largedeal, marketStatus. Attachments live on nsearchives.nseindia.in/corporate/*.pdf. Blocked: quote-equity (403 even with cookies). Dead: historical/bulk-deals, www1.nseindia.com. Archives CSVs (EQUITY_L.csv, bulk.csv, block.csv) work on nsearchives.nseindia.com. No published rate limit; use at least 1.5 s spacing and back off on 403. Helper script: tools/nse_fetch.py.
title: NSE corporate-data APIs (now on www.nseindia.in) - tested access
